identity.headline: Make the hidden structure explicit.
identity.fullStatement: Boundary First Labs is an independent public-interest research and engineering laboratory. Centered on consequence, governance, and repair, BFL researches consequential and public systems for the public good by making hidden structure explicit across software, AI, mathematics, scientific computation, and institutional systems.
identity.heroLead: Boundary First Labs is an independent public-interest research and engineering laboratory centered on consequence, governance, and repair.
identity.heroSupport: We research consequential and public systems for the public good, developing tools for complex systems that must remain understandable, accountable, governable, reconstructible, and repairable as they grow.
identity.domainLine: Across software, AI, mathematics, scientific computation, and institutional systems.
identity.compactStatement: An independent public-interest research and engineering laboratory for consequential and public systems.

systemsAudit.title: Boundary First Systems Audit
systemsAudit.summary: A founder-led technical intervention for consequential software and AI systems where the difficult problem extends beyond implementation.
systemsAudit.availabilityNote: The method and working material are developed. Each audit is configured and produced against the actual system when requested rather than sold as a static, off-the-shelf report.
systemsAudit.idealFor: Teams with systems that technically work but are no longer fully understood—or where hidden assumptions, ownership, dependencies, and consequence paths now obstruct safe delivery or repair.
systemsAudit.successCondition: An engagement succeeds when the team can inspect a shared actual-system map, distinguish known facts from assumptions, identify named defects and owners, and act on a prioritized repair or delivery path.
inputs: A bounded consequential system or product slice
Available code, architecture, requirements, and operating records
Access to the people who build, operate, govern, or depend on it
Known constraints, incidents, uncertainties, and desired decisions
deliverables: Prioritized path toward repair or delivery
boundaries: Scope, access, privacy, evidence, schedule, and success conditions are agreed before work begins.
The audit does not substitute for legal advice, regulatory certification, a security penetration test, or an enterprise-wide transformation unless separately scoped.
Findings distinguish observed system state, supplied records, analysis, assumptions, and recommendations.

relatedTrack.title: AI Consequence-Loop Audit
relatedTrack.description: A bounded application of the Systems Audit to one AI-assisted workflow or product slice, concentrating on authority, false closure, evidence, escalation, and repair loops.

boundaryFirstChess.title: Boundary First Chess
boundaryFirstChess.summary: Boundary First reasoning applied to chess strategy, position evaluation, planning, and decision-making in a constrained, testable environment.
boundaryFirstChess.availabilityNote: The body of work is mature enough to engage now while its public product forms continue to launch.
currentForms: Game reviews and individual instruction available by inquiry
boundaryFirstChess.futureBoundary: Maintained standalone software remains a distinct future product track; its maturity is not implied by the availability of the current Chess work.
boundaryFirstChess.claimBoundary: Chess is both a standalone product and an accessible demonstration of Boundary First reasoning. It is a bounded testbed, not proof that every result transports universally.
